SIX-BOX. (a) PRIOR NUMBERS: SSIM flat 0.7696 +/-0.0005 across iter-8..16 (9 iters); hr pinned 0 at EVERY iter 1..16; PSNR 20.9 dB, RMSE 4.5e-3. (b) FAILURE MODE: REGIME-BOUNDED 2D Gaussian-splat on dense 2304-view Mayo — a lossy compression (512 Gaussians, 0.003M params) that structurally cannot exceed the analytic inverse when the problem is well-posed (full-view), so it lands below the near-complete LD-FBP floor (~0.808) on the PSNR/RMSE-gated headroom metric -> hr=0. (c) UNTRIED IN-BUDGET LEVER MOVING hr OFF 0? NONE. gs_ssim_weight is fully mapped+saturated (0.10->0.15->0.25 PEAK->0.40 over-weighted, falsifier fired) and it LIFTS SSIM but DROPS PSNR 24.1->20.9 dB, so it cannot move the PSNR-gated hr off 0. The only remaining axis is capacity (gs_n_gaussians 512->1024): prior verdict 256->512 gave +0.02 SSIM / 0 hr, and 1024 is bounded the SAME way (more splats still land below the FBP floor on PSNR) AND risks the HARD 20-min wall (iter-10 already 1120.8s @512). No lever changes the PSNR/RMSE gate vs a well-posed analytic baseline. (d) DECISION: EMPTY-PATCH {} confirm run-best — ceiling genuinely exhausted. (e) BUDGET: identical to iter-10, elapsed ~1121s < 1200s HARD < 1800s SLURM wall, figure excluded. (f) BASE_ITER=10 = max-SSIM run-best (0.769672). HARD-WIRED: staged_canonical, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geom, per-sample-ps, bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277, 321px FOV, gs_render=raster (NO fov=False). PREDICTION: SSIM ~0.769 (0.765-0.775), hr 0 — faithful-but-regime-bounded negative result.
